color.note: flaky ships a single light theme. Every value is copied from the Tailwind arbitrary classes in src/app. There is no dark theme in the source.

tokens.name: surface-top
tokens.usage: Top of the page gradient and the PWA background colour. Sets the warm paper tone behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the page gradient (to-b from `surface-top`). Also the fill of the secondary button.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: The one white card that holds each step's form, and bookable calendar days.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Inset panel inside the card: profile editor, Twilio troubleshooting box. Hover fill for the 'Signed in as' chip.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, the wordmark, input values and primary text on `card`, `panel` and `surface-*` (10.9:1 on `card`).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Section questions and legends ('Who are you meeting?', 'What day?', 'Your mobile number') and outline-button text on `card` (6.9:1). Hover colour for quiet text links.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Body copy on result screens, participant lists, the signed-in name, month-nav chevrons, on `card` (5.4:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Field labels under a section question ('Their number', 'Name'), the day header over the plan list, tagline, 'Signed in as', quiet buttons. 3.45:1 on `card`: below AA for 12–14px text. Kept exact from source; flagged.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Fine print under buttons, weekday labels, the '(nobody knows…)' line. 2.5:1 on `card`: fails AA. Kept exact from source; flagged.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Secondary note on the invite page and Twilio error text, on `surface-*` and `panel` (4.3:1 on `card`: just under AA).

tokens.name: whisper
tokens.usage: The footer 'Feedback' link at rest, on `surface-bottom` (1.6:1: deliberately hidden-ish, fails AA). Kept exact; flagged.

tokens.name: whisper-hover
tokens.usage: Footer link hover.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholders, the '+' country separator, underline decoration on quiet links.

tokens.name: line-card
tokens.usage: 1px border on the main card and inset panels; divider inside the profile editor.

tokens.name: line-input
tokens.usage: 2px underline on idle text inputs and the idle border of time-of-day toggles. Decorative: the label carries meaning (1.3:1).

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: 1px border on the outline (cancel/keep) button.

tokens.name: day-idle
tokens.usage: In-month calendar days with no plans (not tappable).

tokens.name: day-outside
tokens.usage: Calendar days that spill in from the previous or next month.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: THE brand colour. Primary button fill, focus underline on inputs, selected calendar day, time-of-day selected fill, theme-color meta. White text on it is 2.95:1 (fails AA at 16px). Kept exact from source; flagged.

tokens.name: terracotta-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. Text colour of the 'flake' pill (3.6:1 on `card`).

tokens.name: terracotta-active
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed; 'flake' pill hover text; remove-number hover.

tokens.name: terracotta-tint
tokens.usage: Hover wash on the 'flake' pill and on bookable calendar days.

tokens.name: terracotta-tint-2
tokens.usage: Pressed wash on the 'flake' pill and on bookable calendar days.

tokens.name: terracotta-line
tokens.usage: Idle 1px border of the 'flake' pill.

tokens.name: oat-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary (oat) button hover.

tokens.name: oat-active
tokens.usage: Secondary (oat) button pressed.

tokens.name: oat-ghost
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of round ghost icon buttons (pick from contacts).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Confirm colour: the 'Done' / 'Nice' button on result screens, border of the add-number button. White text on it is 2.4:1 (fails AA). Kept exact from source; flagged.

tokens.name: sage-hover
tokens.usage: 'Done' button hover.

tokens.name: sage-active
tokens.usage: 'Done' button pressed.

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: Text for the 'recommit' pill, the add-number '+' and 'you're covered' status on `card` (4.6:1).

tokens.name: sage-ink-hover
tokens.usage: 'recommit' pill hover text.

tokens.name: sage-line
tokens.usage: Idle 1px border of the 'recommit' pill.

tokens.name: sage-tint
tokens.usage: 'recommit' pill hover wash.

tokens.name: sage-tint-2
tokens.usage: 'recommit' pill pressed wash.

tokens.name: sage-tint-3
tokens.usage: Add-number button hover wash.

tokens.name: sage-tint-4
tokens.usage: Add-number button pressed wash.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive only: 'Delete my account' confirm button fill (white text 5.8:1) and link text.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button and link hover.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Underline decoration on the 'Delete my account' link.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Inline error banner fill (Tailwind red-50).

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Inline error banner text on `error-bg` (Tailwind red-600, 4.4:1: just under AA).
